monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured in the repository. The conversion improvement is a product-neutral concentrate-container decision system covering original-package preservation, exact contact materials, usable cavity, closure and marketing claims, empty return-window testing, locked storage, returns, and first-year cost. The homepage finder now routes concentrate-plus-gear intent directly to it. No merchant, model, live price, discount, ranking, availability claim, fabricated test, product image, or paid placement was added; buying nothing remains a valid outcome.

image_qa.note: The two new articles use original text, evidence tables, checklists, and existing brand interface assets; the guide-finder change is semantic and behavioral. No diabetes device, cannabis product, container, liner, tool, merchant, affiliate, stock image, product photo, or generated image was added or changed, so there is no exact-product mismatch or new licensing issue.

search_console.decision: The October 5–November 1 report is six days old and valid: 786 impressions, four clicks, 0.509% CTR, and average position 24.632. ‘510 vs disposable’ had two impressions at position 12 but already maps to the existing comparison page; Delaware, federal-property, and Montana signals were single-impression or single-click samples. Blue Dream had 18 impressions near position 45, outside the target 4–20 range. Those signals were deliberately ignored as too weak, duplicative, or out of range, so no item is primarily Data-led. The report served as a cannibalization guard while the batch expands distinct diabetes-safety and concentrate-container intent.

authority.action: Published a citation-worthy cannabis-and-diabetes safety matrix, DKA and vomiting stop gate, exact product-and-glucose record, and clinician-handoff worksheet grounded in the ADA 2026 Standards of Care, CDC, NIDDK, and FDA. Reciprocal links strengthen the medication-interaction, cannabinoid-hyperemesis, urgent-response, and diabetes-safety cluster. No speculative outreach target was logged and no outreach was sent.
